zh.text: NDX (-3.7%) 今日因令人失望的 $INTC 及其他科技股業績，以及對龐大 AI 資本建設回報的不確定性而遭受重挫。主要驅動因素：$INTC 因 PC 銷量疲弱而指引第四季營收低於預期後下跌 30%；$GOOGL 和 $AMZN 本週業績弱於預期；科技巨頭持續增加資本支出；鷹派聯儲評論指向年底前再次加息。抵消因素：10 年期國債收益率從 9/30 的 5.3% 降至今日的 4.94%。

en.text: NDX (-3.7%) getting crushed today on disappointing $INTC and other tech earnings and uncertainty about returns on huge AI capital buildout. Key drivers: $INTC -30% after guiding weaker 4Q revs on sluggish PC volume; weaker earnings from $GOOGL and $AMZN; increased capex from tech heavyweights; hawkish Fed commentary pointing to another rate hike by year-end. Offsetting: 10-yr yields declined from 5.3% on 9/30 to 4.94% today.

zh.text: Steve Hanke 指出埃及通脹率為 14.0%/年，是其長期目標 3-7%/年上限的兩倍，埃及鎊是垃圾貨幣，如石頭般下沉。

en.text: Steve Hanke notes Egypt’s inflation is 14.0%/yr, double the upper end of its long-term target of 3-7%/yr, and the Egyptian pound is a junk currency sinking like a stone.

zh.text: 另一個大週即將到來，包括就業報告以及 $AAPL、$PLTR、$AMD、$ARM、$QCOM 等財報。週一早上可獲取預覽：https://t3live.com/rd。（@RedDogT3）

en.text: Another monster week is coming with the jobs report + $AAPL $PLTR $AMD $ARM $QCOM earnings and more. Get preview on Monday morning at https://t3live.com/rd. By @RedDogT3.

zh.text: 當信用利差提供真實補償時風險偏好，否則風險規避。這就是JOJO的一句話總結。基於市場實際信號的戰術性信用輪動。

en.text: Risk-on when credit spreads offer real compensation, risk-off when they do not. That is $JOJO in a sentence. Tactical credit rotation based on what the market is actually telling you.

zh.text: 想通了？你的意思是「是的，Andy，你在 2025 年 8 月是對的，當時你和 @LynAldenContact 以及 @_DannyKnowles 辯論穩定幣，你說增長將會緩慢，因為使用案例僅限於持有美元紙幣和硬幣的外國人，而整個作為美元現金新需求來源的想法只是希望和夢想，而且 $CRCL 是死錢」。是的，我是對的。

en.text: Came around? You mean 'yeah Andy you were right in August 2025 when you and @LynAldenContact and @_DannyKnowles debated stable coins and you said growth was going to be slow because the use case was limited to foreigners with USD currency bills and coins and the whole idea of it being a new source of demand for USD cash was hopes and dreams and also the $CRCL was dead money'. Yep I was right.

zh.text: Robin Brooks 展示各資產回報與油價的 30 日滾動相關性；對抗熱戰回歸的最佳對沖是做多美元尤其對新興市場，而標普 500、黃金和白銀易受影響。

en.text: Robin Brooks presents rolling 30-day correlations of various asset returns with oil prices; best hedge against a return to a 'hot' war is long the US Dollar especially versus EM, while the S&P 500, gold and silver are vulnerable.

zh.text: 關於關稅，Milton Friedman說：「我們稱關稅為保護措施。它確實保護。它很好地保護消費者免受一件事：低價格。」關稅人Donald Trump應該聽聽。

en.text: On tariffs, Milton Friedman said: "We call a tariff a protective measure. It does protect. It protects the consumer very well against one thing. It protects the consumer against low prices." Donald Trump, the TARIFF MAN, should take a listen.
